findings.body: Every new Refused construction omits next_step, which is required by src/forge/repo.py:52. An unverifiable process therefore causes an uncaught TypeError and traceback instead of the promised one-line refusal. The same defect affects cancellation, worker-only restrictions, argument validation and failed termination at machine.py:87,121,219,221,235. Tests/test_lanes_view.py:194,198,206 accept these tracebacks because the displayed source contains the expected message. Supply next_step at every site and make the command assertions reject tracebacks.
findings.title: Not done: unverifiable process identity refuses with one line

findings.body: The standard requires: "Touch only what the task needs." The shared command boundary now retries Git configuration failures, and tests/test_close_test_runs_wait_in_line.py:125–137 injects that unrelated failure into the close-queue test. Neither change implements core budgeting, lane entries, diagnostics or cancellation. The handoff names both files and explains the Windows failure, but establishes no dependency on this task. Move src/forge/repo.py's retry change and that test modification into a separate repair.
findings.title: Standard: Touch only what the task needs

findings.body: The retained checker launches Autoreview without process-group options and calls started(pid), as verified in tests/fixtures/pr-check-before-branch-diff/review.py:531–533. This stop path nevertheless requests group termination through src/forge/codex.py:624–625. Since that process does not lead its own group, it remains alive and stop cannot free its place. Older Claude workers and readers have the same mismatch. The compatibility ruling remains valid; cancellation must also support those ungrouped processes safely. The existing-queue test converts records from a newly grouped launch, so it does not exercise this case.
findings.title: Handle existing agents without a dedicated process group

findings.body: Review admission snapshots chosen, but Autoreview defaults and unavailable-model fallback update only selected at src/forge/review.py:570–576. Board JSON consequently continues showing null or the unavailable model during the running review. Split design workers likewise replace chosen when falling back to Codex at src/forge/worker.py:167–191 without updating their lane entry. Refresh the active entry's model and effort when either caller changes its selection.
findings.title: Refresh lane metadata when the selected model changes

findings.body: Actual test commands still bypass the shared entries: src/forge/fasttest.py:171–172 launches directly, while close uses the separate ticket queue at src/forge/review.py:279–288. The board therefore cannot expose their output or progress, and stop cannot cancel tests or end an item's worker and test together. Plans/FORGE-LANES-1.md:142 assigns this integration and its command-level checks to TESTS, so this remains deferred advice rather than an AGENTS blocker.
findings.title: Later: connect test entries and cancellation in TESTS
